title: email_verify response
description: A known address gets token. A new address gets needsProfile: true and pending. Both formats are fixed by BACKEND ADR-20: token is the adult session token v<keyver>.<tester_id>.<iat>.<mac> (MAC over adult|tester_id|iat|keyver with SIGN_KEY version keyver); pending is the 30-minute token p<keyver>.<email_hash>.<invite_id>.<age_band>.<iat>.<mac>, signed with the separate pending key. The patterns check the shape only; the server checks the MAC, the age and tok_after.
